title: Rome's Corrupt Fire Brigade
hook: Marcus Crassus made billions by negotiating real estate while the house burned down.

scenes.text: In ancient Rome, cramped wooden apartment blocks called insulae caught fire constantly from charcoal braziers and oil lamps.
